name: borla
description: Borla — real-time matchmaker connecting Ghanaian households with nearby roaming waste collectors. CSCD 602 capstone project.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
